mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS positionId,p.import_file_id AS importFileId,p.position_code AS positionCode,p.position_name AS positionName, p.department_name AS departmentName,p.organization_name AS organizationName,p.province,p.city,p.district,p.recruit_count AS recruitCount, p.education_requirement AS educationRequirement,p.major_requirement AS majorRequirement,p.raw_data AS rawData FROM job_match m JOIN job_position p ON p.id=m.job_position_id WHERE m.profile_id=#{profileId} AND m.match_result='MATCH' AND m.import_file_id=#{importId} ORDER BY p.id
